chunks: Hadith 1409 — Maʿrūf ibn Kharrabūdh narrated from one of them — meaning Abū Jaʿfar and Abū ʿAbdillāh عليهما السلام — who said:

There is no god but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous. There is no god but Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the seven earths, and whatever is in them and whatever is between them, and Lord of the Mighty Throne.
O Allah, You are: "Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth."

And You are Allah, the adornment of the heavens and the earth. And You are Allah, the beauty of the heavens and the earth. And You are Allah, the support of the heavens and the earth. And You are Allah, the sustainer of the heavens and the earth. And You are Allah, the helper of those who cry out for help. And You are Allah, the aid of those who seek relief. And You are Allah, the one who relieves the distressed. And You are Allah, the one who eases the grief of the sorrowful. And You are Allah, the one who answers the supplication of the compelled. And You are Allah, the God of the worlds. And You are Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. And You are Allah, the remover of evil. And You are Allah; through You every need is brought down, O Allah.

Nothing turns back Your anger except Your forbearance, and nothing saves from Your punishment except Your mercy, and nothing saves from You except humble entreaty to You. So grant me, from Your presence, O my God, a mercy by which You make me needless of the mercy of anyone besides You, by the power through which You gave life to all that is in the lands, and by which You raise the dead of the servants. And do not destroy me in grief until You forgive me, have mercy on me, make known to me the answering of my supplication, grant me well-being until the end of my term, pardon my stumble, do not let my enemy rejoice over me, and do not give him power over my neck.

O Allah, if You raise me, then who is there that can lower me? And if You lower me, then who is there that can raise me? And if You destroy me, then who is there that can come between You and me, or object to You regarding anything of my affair? And I have known that there is no injustice in Your judgment, and no haste in Your vengeance. Only one who fears missing out acts hastily, and only the weak needs injustice. And You are exalted above that, O my God. So do not make me a target for affliction, nor an object of Your vengeance.

And grant me respite, give me relief, pardon my stumble, and do not follow one affliction upon the heels of another affliction. For You see my weakness and the paucity of my means. I seek refuge in You tonight, so grant me refuge. And I seek protection in You from the Fire, so protect me. And I ask You for Paradise, so do not deprive me.
Then supplicate to Allah with whatever you wish, and seek Allah’s forgiveness seventy times.

key_terms.التَّضَرُّعُ: humble pleading and earnest entreaty before Allah
key_terms.النَّارِ: the Fire; hellfire from which protection is sought
key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the final reward being requested
key_terms.الْعَافِيَةَ: well-being, safety, and preservation from harm
key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the Witr prayer of the night prayer
key_terms.حِلْمُكَ: Your forbearance; Allah’s restraint despite anger
key_terms.رَحْمَتُكَ: Your mercy; the means of deliverance from punishment
key_terms.قُنُوتِ: the supplicatory standing in salat (prayer), here in Witr

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication to recite in the qunūt of Witr according to Imam al-Bāqir or Imam al-Ṣādiq عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a supplication for the qunūt of Witr, combining praise of Allah’s majesty, mercy, and sustaining power with confession of need and weakness before Him. It emphasizes reliance upon Allah alone, seeking His mercy, protection from punishment, relief from affliction, and hope for al-Jannah, followed by personal duʿa and seeking forgiveness.
